primary_goal: honor priority/deadline/aging promotion when mixed phase batching shares a token budget
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

scope.phase: decode/prefill cohort choice under shared max_num_batched_tokens
scope.trigger: best non-decode rank strictly outranks best decode rank while mixed batching is enabled

problem_domain_closure.selection: fixed: promoted non-decode phase is reserved before mixed decode
problem_domain_closure.budget: fixed: remaining token/sequence budget can fill decode; no-promotion path preserved
problem_domain_closure.controls: existing equal-rank mixed tests plus priority control passed; deadline/aging rank smoke observed
problem_domain_closure.evaluation: priority request TTFT/finish parity with non-mixed control
problem_domain_closure.api: online report consumes corrected request scheduling order through existing path
problem_domain_closure.error: no new error path; failed cohort construction falls back to existing decode/non-decode selection

data_roles.holdout: existing mixed batching, single-slot, hybrid, deadline/priority scheduler tests

guardrails: do not revisit closed H18 swap or H19 legacy report domains
do not create a candidate without a real trigger and falsifier
no native accuracy claim without native observation
next_step: promote after final records, commit, push, and remote verification
